_comment: Grafana dashboard panels for the HTTP /api/login migration deprecation telemetry.
Drop these into an existing dashboard via the 'Import JSON' panel option, or
merge into a fresh dashboard JSON under .panels[]. Counters are emitted by
go/login/internal/logic/clientplayerlogin/deprecation.go and exposed at
the host configured under login.yaml `Prometheus:` (default 127.0.0.1:9101/metrics).
path label values:
new       = Java Gateway POST /api/login (no gate session).
gate_bind = gate-forwarded Login with auth_type=access_token: the new flow's mandatory
session-bind step (only writer of login_session). Not deprecated and NOT
affected by LegacyGateLoginEnabled; every new-flow login emits one new + one gate_bind.
legacy    = gate-forwarded Login with password / third-party credentials (the path the kill switch closes).
Two panels:
1. Stacked-area: legacy / new / gate_bind request rate over time.
ARCH §12 T+1 exit criterion = legacy line trends to (and stays near) zero.
2. Single-stat: legacy / (legacy + new) ratio for the last 5 minutes;
gate_bind is excluded from the denominator so one new-flow login counts once.
Alert at >5% (rollback signal) or <1% (T+2 ready).
Counted per request at Login() entry, before authentication (since 2026-10-18): auth failures,
lock contention and kill-switch rejections are all included, so path=legacy keeps showing the
remaining tail after LegacyGateLoginEnabled=false. auth_type label values are bounded:
password / access_token / registered provider names (satoken, wechat, qq, netease), anything else = unknown.
Per-auth_type breakdowns are available by adding `auth_type` to the legend
(e.g. legend: '{{path}} / {{auth_type}}'); useful when WeChat/QQ stay on
legacy longer than password as third-party SDKs roll out.

panels.title: Login Path Request Rate (legacy / new / gate_bind)
panels.description: rate of ClientPlayerLogin.Login calls, split by entry path. ARCH §12 T+1 exit criterion: legacy must trend to zero before flipping LegacyGateLoginEnabled=false. gate_bind is the new flow's gate session bind and stays non-zero by design.

panels.title: Legacy Path Share (last 5m)
panels.description: Fraction of recent logins still authenticating with credentials on the gate-TCP path (gate_bind excluded from the denominator). >5% = block T+2; <1% = T+2 ready.

panels.title: Login Path by Auth Type
panels.description: Per-auth_type breakdown to spot 'wechat traffic stuck on legacy' vs 'password fully migrated' patterns.

_comment: Alertmanager rule (paste under groups.rules in alert-rules.yaml).
Fires when legacy traffic stays >5% for 10 minutes — that's the
rollback signal, not the T+2 trigger. Pair with a separate one-shot
alert when legacy drops to zero for 24h to ping ops about T+2 readiness.

annotations.summary: Legacy gate-Login path receiving >5% of login traffic
annotations.description: ARCH §12 expected this to drop after T+1 cutover. Investigate before flipping LegacyGateLoginEnabled=false.
